test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is an example of private sector industry in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tata Iron and Steel Company**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Tata Iron and Steel Company (TISCO), now known as Tata Steel Ltd, is one of the largest private sector steel manufacturing companies in India.
 
• Tata Steel was established by Jamsetji Tata in 1907 and is headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.
 
• It is part of the Tata Group, which is a prominent Indian multinational conglomerate.
 
• Tata Steel is known for its significant contribution to the industrialization of India and remains a leading player in the global steel industry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL)**

 
 
• It is a public sector undertaking and one of the largest steel-making companies in India.
 
• SAIL is owned and operated by the Government of India.
 
• It was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in New Delhi.
 
• SAIL operates and owns 5 integrated steel plants and 3 special steel plants in India.
 
 
 
• **Oil India Limited (OIL)**
 
 
• It is the second-largest hydrocarbon exploration and production public sector company in India.
 
• OIL is owned by the Government of India.
 
• It was founded in 1959 and is headquartered in Duliajan, Assam, India.
 
• OIL is involved in the exploration, development, and production of crude oil and natural gas.
 
 
 
• **Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL)**
 
 
• It is a public sector engineering and manufacturing company in India.
 
• BHEL is owned by the Government of India.
 
• It was established in 1964 and is headquartered in New Delhi.
 
• BHEL is engaged in the design, engineering, manufacturing, construction, testing, commissioning, and servicing of a wide range of products and services for the core sectors of the economy, including power, transmission, industry, transportation, renewable energy, oil & gas, and defense.
